svg.title: AP2 / A2A purchase demo: three isolated roles
svg.desc: The user approves in the authority UI, published only on localhost through a UI bridge. Authority also joins the internal network; buyer and seller join only the internal network. Only authority holds the issuer private key. Authority provisions buyer and seller over separately authenticated TLS control routes. Buyer and seller exchange A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC with AP2 documents in metadata and data Artifacts. Each role has its own persistent volume. Seller maintains acceptance and processor ledgers. Public keys and the test CA are shared read-only.
svg.text: 購入Agent × 販売Agent / AP2 + A2A
